paragraphs: The GLA45 AMG uses the M139 - a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder engine, one of the most powerful four-cylinder production engines ever built. Hand-assembled under AMG's "One Man, One Engine" philosophy, the M139 was introduced with the X156-generation GLA45 AMG in 2013 and continued into the H247 generation when the GLA-Class was redesigned from 2020. The GLA45 AMG sits above the GLA35 AMG in the range, offering a more powerful state of tune from the same M139 architecture.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLA45 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLA45 AMG from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
